text:
Ravi: Heads-up: publishflow opened a regen diff that bumped clients/js minor even though only generated comments changed. Anyone on typegen?
Priya: Likely example block reorder in the OpenAPI spec; typegen emits different doc comments.
Sam: CI snippet: 
``
regen-check failed: diff in clients/js/src/index.ts
+  // example: signup flow (order changed)
   export function createClient() {}
```
ci-bot: Build 863001 failed at regen-check.
Priya: Local fix: run node scripts/normalize-openapi.js before yarn typegen and the diff disappears.
Ravi: Plan: Sam to hotfix publishflow to normalize spec pre-typegen, Priya to add conservative guard treating example-only diffs as docs, and rollback if any accidental publish occurred.
devex-bot: Created issue #8033 and assigned Priya+Sam.
Sam: Opening hotfix PR now (will add unit that shuffles examples). ETA 90m.
Priya: Will keep typegen changes conservative so we don't hide real API changes.
Ravi: Also watch sample-app CI for auth/retry flakes after any publish/revert and post here if seen. :eyes:
